claims.statement: An advertisement for Tom Allen gave his place at 619 Market street, St. Louis, with a free concert (printed as 'toncert') every evening.
claims.excerpt: world, 619 Market street. Free toncert eve

claims.statement: The advertisement describes Tom Allen as 'retired'; the rest of the title is garbled.
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN, retired mt ep, i be oa of ae

notes: Hint said 'champion pugilist of the world'; the text does not show that wording (the title is garbled), so only 'retired' is claimed.
